title: Latte
tagline: Interface to save videos for hippo wearable on a decentralized permissionless platform
description: The android application allows users of https://myhippo.life/ wearable device to save, stream and view livestream and saved video content via livepeer for urgent care augmented wearable clients. Pilot it with two urgent care clinics where the demo will ensure the videos can be live streamed, viewed by physicians and can be actioned upon. The content will obtain consent by the patient and physician. Collaboration with Livepeer to ensure the content has HIPAA and HITRUST compliance.
how_its_made: Utilize live peer's sample android project to build a react native app that can be installed as an apk into the hippo wearable. Further work is needed to ensure the content adheres to HIPAA compliance, by ensuring encryption at rest and in transit to protect patient confidentiality.
